name: 清爽随身固体香体止汗膏款
description: 从白底主图到腋下涂抹、香型轮换与配方透明对照的身体护理套图

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF for packshots, warm blush-to-caramel gradient #E7C6B5 into #8A5B41 for benefit and texture screens, pale sand-grey #EDE9E4 studio sweep for body screens, one clear glass shelf line reused as the stage
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft diffused studio light from the upper left with a broad white fill card, low-contrast wrap shadows, one soft contact shadow grounding every object, satin highlights on skin and case, no hard speculars, daylight-balanced on body screens
styleLock.surfaceSystem: pale matte stone counter #EDE9E4, clear glass shelf edge, warm off-white paper field #FAF7F2 for information screens
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif with generous letter spacing, single weight family; every source headline is stripped and replaced by empty reserved copy zones
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line tick glyphs and small circular outline badges in #8A5B41 only, always delivered as empty slots
styleLock.presentationRules: upright product with a stable slight 3/4 or straight-on angle across packshot, benefit and line-up screens; body screens always cropped from the jawline down with no identifiable face; variant accents may differ per unit only on the line-up screen; the label is never redesigned
noDrift: no identifiable faces or model likeness
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm minimal body-care visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, pale sand-grey #EDE9E4, caramel brown #8A5B41 and blush apricot #E7C6B5, with product-matched accent colours allowed only on the variant line-up screen; warm tone throughout; backgrounds are seamless white, a blush-to-caramel gradient or a pale sand-grey studio sweep with one clear glass shelf line; soft diffused upper-left key light with broad fill, low-contrast wrap shadows and a single soft contact shadow, never hard speculars; modern geometric sans-serif with generous letter spacing; thin single-weight line tick glyphs and circular outline badge slots in caramel brown #8A5B41, always left empty; stable upright slight 3/4 product angle and scale, body screens cropped from the jawline down with no identifiable face; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击：整支直立膏体干净呈现，承担主图合规白底位。
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, product standing upright and centred, full body inside frame
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light from the camera-left with a white fill card opposite, soft contact shadow only
shots.whitespace: even margin on all four sides, no extra whitespace beyond the product block
shots.promptTemplate: Clean packshot of {product}, the whole upright unit centred and fully inside the frame. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed straight-on at eye level so the label face reads flat and symmetrical, with no tilt and no cropping. Bright even high-key studio light from the camera-left with a white fill card on the shadow side, one soft contact shadow grounding the base. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF, nothing else in the frame. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame with an even margin on all four sides. 8K commercial beauty e-commerce quality. Negative: no ribbon banners, no badge or seal shapes, no text or digits rendered in frame, no hands, no props, no watermark, no fake logo, no gradient background, no floating product without a contact shadow, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 一秒交代核心利益，右侧立产品、左侧整片留白承接标题。
shots.camera: straight-on eye level, product placed right of centre on the edge of a glass shelf
shots.lighting: soft warm key from the upper left with gentle falloff across the gradient, faint shelf reflection
shots.whitespace: generous empty negative space across the left 40% reserved for post-production copy
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The upright product stands right of centre on the edge of a clear glass shelf, photographed straight-on at eye level with the full body visible and a faint reflection under the shelf line. Soft warm key light from the upper left with a gentle falloff across a warm blush-to-caramel gradient backdrop #E7C6B5 fading into #8A5B41, one soft contact shadow at the base. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame while the left 40% stays as generous empty negative space for post-production copy. Negative: no rendered words, letters or digits, no headline shape, no logo, no props on the shelf, no hands, no busy texture inside the empty copy area, no hard shadow, no colour drift away from the locked gradient.

shots.intent: 用原料道具把气味翻译成可看的生活方式，建立代入与偏好。
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down across the styled tabletop so props sit along the bottom edge
shots.lighting: bright soft daylight-balanced light from the upper left, gentle directional shadows falling to the right
shots.background: light warm grey studio surface #F4F1EC with a matching seamless horizon
shots.props: a few raw scent-cue props placed low to either side: one halved fibrous shell, two dried pods, one pale blossom, never covering the product
shots.whitespace: clear empty band across the top 30% for a short headline
shots.promptTemplate: Styled scent-mood scene: {product} stands upright at the centre of a bright seamless tabletop, with a few raw scent-cue props placed low to either side, one halved fibrous shell, two dried pods and one pale blossom, none of them covering the product. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down across the styled surface so the props sit along the bottom edge of the frame while the upright product stays clearly the subject. Bright soft daylight-balanced light from the upper left, gentle directional shadows falling to the right onto a light warm grey studio surface #F4F1EC with a matching seamless horizon. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame with a clear empty band across the top 30% for a short headline. Negative: no readable text, no ingredient or efficacy claims, no product-name lettering on the props, no crumbs or mess, no duplicated props, no plastic-looking botanicals, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 示范真实使用动作与顺滑肤感，右侧空栏承接要点清单。
shots.camera: clean 90-degree side profile of a raised arm and shoulder, cropped at the jawline
shots.lighting: soft directional studio light from the camera-right with a broad wrap fill, real skin sheen, 5500K
shots.whitespace: open empty column down the right 35% for a short callout list
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle usage scene: one hand glides {product} across the underside of a raised arm, photographed from a clean 90-degree side profile and cropped at the jawline so no face and no identity is ever shown. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Soft directional studio light from the camera-right with a broad wrap-around fill at a 5500K balance, real skin texture with visible pores and fine lines and only a gentle sheen. Pale sand-grey seamless studio sweep #EDE9E4 behind the shoulder. Arm and product occupy 40-50% of the frame with an open empty column down the right 35% for a short callout list. Negative: no visible face, no recognizable likeness, no deformed or extra fingers, no white residue smear, no cropped-off limb ends, no rendered text, no watermark, no fake logo, no over-smoothed plastic skin.

shots.intent: 把产品放进健身与通勤日常，强化随身补香的使用动机。
shots.camera: slight 3/4 angle across an athletic torso framed from collarbone to hip, head outside the frame
shots.lighting: even soft studio light from the camera-left at daylight balance, subtle fabric and muscle shading
shots.props: one plain unbranded athletic top in muted grey
shots.whitespace: open negative space across the upper left 30% for an icon callout stack
shots.promptTemplate: Active-lifestyle scene: a relaxed hand holds {product} against the waist, the body framed from collarbone to hip at a slight 3/4 angle with the head entirely outside the frame. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even soft studio light from the camera-left at a daylight balance, subtle shading across fabric weave and shoulder, real skin texture kept intact. Cool pale grey studio wall #E4E5E6 behind, one plain unbranded athletic top in muted grey as the only wardrobe cue. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame with open negative space across the upper left 30% for an icon callout stack. Negative: no face, no recognizable model, no brand marks on clothing, no squeezed or extra fingers, no rendered text, no watermark, no fake logo, no glossy over-retouching.

shots.intent: 微距证明膏体饱满顺滑、贴合推口结构，替代空口功效话术。
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro tilted slightly downward onto the domed core, shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: soft top light with a broad white reflection card so one gentle highlight sweeps across the dome
shots.whitespace: upper third kept clear and empty for a short headline
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of the domed solid core of {product}, tight zoom on the smooth surface and on the rim where the core meets the case. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed at a slightly downward macro angle with shallow depth of field and the near edge crisply sharp. Soft top light with a broad white reflection card so one gentle highlight sweeps across the dome, revealing a matte creamy texture without harsh speculars. Warm caramel-to-blush gradient background #8A5B41 fading into #E7C6B5. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame and the upper third stays clear and empty for a short headline. Negative: no blurry subject, no visible embossed lettering or engraved marks, no cracks, air bubbles or fingerprints, no water droplets, no banding artifacts, no text, no watermark, no invented surface pattern.

shots.intent: 顶视阵列铺陈质地并留出一整列空白排除项位，讲清配方立场。
shots.camera: flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle
shots.lighting: bright even overhead light, soft short shadows hugging each rim, no long dramatic shadows
shots.props: several identical domed cores laid in a diagonal rhythm, empty rounded pill rows and blank circular tick slots at the side
shots.whitespace: left 40% stays clean white negative space for a stacked short list
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic flat lay: several domed cores of {product} arranged in a diagonal rhythm on a brilliant white seamless surface #FBFAF8, photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Bright even overhead light with soft short shadows hugging each rim so nothing looks lifted off the surface. The cluster occupies 35-40% of the frame while the left 40% stays clean white negative space for a stacked short list; empty rounded pill rows and blank circular tick slots may sit in that space but must stay completely letterless. Negative: no readable words, letters or digits, no strikethrough copy, no dense body text, no duplicated or merged product shapes, no cast shadow across the copy area, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用左右双栏与勾叉位承接配方立场对照，两侧主张全部留空不自证。
shots.camera: straight-on symmetrical two-panel layout, both panels identically framed and cropped
shots.lighting: even soft head-on light on both panels so neither side looks dramatised
shots.background: deep cocoa field #6B4A38 with a soft blush seam #E7C6B5 down the centre
shots.whitespace: empty rounded rows above each panel for paired claims
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce two-panel comparison layout: {product} appears once in each matched panel at the same straight-on symmetrical angle, identical crop and identical scale, the panels differing only in one blank highlighted row against one dimmed row. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even soft head-on light on both panels so neither side reads dramatised, deep cocoa field #6B4A38 with a soft blush seam #E7C6B5 dividing the centre. Empty rounded pill rows plus plain tick and cross glyph slots sit above each panel, all deliberately blank. The pair occupies 50-60% of the frame across both panels. Negative: no real competitor product or brand, no readable words or digits, no percentages or test data, no fabricated results, no unbalanced lighting between the two panels, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 把可选气味与形态摆上同一架，完成挑选并提高连带。
shots.camera: row of sibling units photographed from a slightly low angle looking gently upward along a glass shelf
shots.lighting: consistent even studio light across every unit, soft contact shadows on the shelf, no lighting drift
shots.background: pale cool grey seamless #EDEFEE with one clear glass shelf line
shots.props: one clear glass shelf, one unit standing on its removed cap and one lying unit at the end of the row
shots.whitespace: upper 30% left empty for a short line-up title
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant line-up: {product} shown as a row of sibling units that differ only in their accent colour, terracotta #B4653C, deep teal #2E6E6B, olive #7A8B3F and sand #C8A876, one unit standing on its removed cap and one lying at the end of the row. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a slightly low angle looking gently upward along a clear glass shelf so the row recovers a little stature, with consistent even studio light across every unit and soft contact shadows on the shelf. Pale cool grey seamless background #EDEFEE. The whole row occupies 60-70% of the frame overall with the upper 30% left empty for a short line-up title. Negative: no readable scent names, no text or digits, no star rows or award graphics, no review counts, no duplicated or fused units, no lighting drift between variants, no colour drift on any accent, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 以透明配方对照与背标版式收口降风险，表格单元一律留空。
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down onto the product turned to its back panel beside an upright table card
shots.lighting: even flat high-key studio light, no dramatic shadow, fine paper texture visible
shots.background: warm off-white paper field #FAF7F2 inside a thin cocoa rule frame #8A5B41
shots.props: one plain ruled two-column table card standing upright
shots.whitespace: generous empty margin around the ruled table and along both card edges
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce transparency close: the product {product} turned to show its plain back panel, standing at a slight angle beside a clean two-column ruled table card on paper, photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down so both sit inside the same light. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even flat high-key studio light with no dramatic shadow and a visible fine paper grain. Warm off-white paper field #FAF7F2 inside a thin cocoa rule frame #8A5B41, the table rows drawn as empty ruled cells with no letters at all. Product and card together occupy 50-60% of the frame with generous empty margin around the ruled table. Negative: no legible ingredient names, no barcode, no address, contact details or store information, no certification or seal artwork, no dense body text, no digits, no watermark, no fake logo.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：001 白底直立单品，下方叠两条横幅缎带字样块；002 暖色渐层背景，产品立于玻璃层板右端，左半屏为大字标题；003 膏体穹顶微距，顶部两行标题；004 浅灰台面中央立产品，四周散落原料道具，左上角棕色标题；005 顶视多颗穹顶膏体斜向阵列，左上四行排除式清单；006 侧身抬臂涂抹，画面裁至下颌以下，右下三条带勾圆点要点；007 运动背心躯干手握产品，左上三条带勾圆点要点；008 玻璃层板上一排同族不同强调色的产品与备用盖，上方星条与评价数；009 白底直立背标，密集成分/用法/警示文字与条码区块；010 蓝绿渐层纯文字立场卡，多行排除式短句与字标图形；011 蓝框白底双栏对照表，逐行左列名词右列释义。品类判定依据：全部图为腋下用固体香体膏（推管＋穹顶膏体），无着色、无工具、无喷雾瓶器，故归「护肤个护／身体护理」，不入「美妆彩妆／香氛」，也不入「家居日用／香氛」；源类目提示与图一致。已剥离内容：品牌字标与系列字样、原平台店铺字样、评价星条与评价数、抑味时长与成分排除原句、净含量数字、条码与联系方式、全部英文标题与要点原句（改为留白区与空白表格单元）；模特一律写作颈部以下裁切的无身份局部；腋下涂抹只保留动作与肤感结构，不含任何功效断言。
